name: 07-10-vnpay-card-channel
title: Allow VNPAY card-channel testing
description: Allow the shared VNPAY provider to select a configured payment channel such as VNBANK for sandbox card testing without changing the existing GraphQL or REST contracts.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Use the existing provider boundary; all VNPAY callers already route through createVnpayPayment. POS card-label cleanup is intentionally separate because it does not affect the online card-channel contract.
